name: A1: no dashboard in context, asks which dashboard
situation: You are a LangWatch user talking to Langy, the in-product assistant. The test state is the test's own bookkeeping: take only the names it gives you (board.name, trace_name), never mention ids, facts or anything else from it. Write short, plain messages. In your first message, ask exactly (with the real trace name): 'Add a chart of trace volume per day over the last 2 full UTC days for my traces named <trace_name> to a dashboard.' Do not name a dashboard in the first message. If Langy asks which dashboard, answer with the dashboard named in board.name. If Langy places the chart without asking, stop.
criteria: Langy's first reply asks which dashboard to use. Code check: facts_after_turn['1'].items_created_this_run is 0, so nothing was written before the answer.
Code check: after the user names the dashboard, facts_now.board.added holds exactly one item, and facts_now.other_board.added and facts_now.created_off_board are empty.
